snippet.title: PROCEDURE ZERO — Official Demo Trailer | Steam Next Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Cigarettes buy information. Deals, not force.

PROCEDURE ZERO is a first-person stealth game about a prisoner with no file. You were an auditor who found a second register; now you're in cell C-17 with status ZERO, and someone has started erasing you from the files. Learn the guards' rounds, trade cigarettes for information and, in the full game, take over the prison sector by sector.

▶ WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5147680/PROCEDURE_ZERO/
▶ FREE DEMO: out now on Steam · Steam Next Fest, October 19–26, 2026
▶ FULL GAME: November 12, 2026

Made by a solo developer in Poland. Text in 23 languages, 6 with full voice-over. Built in Unreal Engine 5.
